panels.title: Big questions
points: Only about a tenth of the energy at one trophic level reaches the next. Why is that the strongest argument for eating more plant food?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by what the hands of people have earned' (Ar-Rum 30:41). Ecology shows how human choices change the balance Allah placed in creation.
